_readme: Copy this file, replace the ids with real ones from the catalog you are tuning, and point
the evaluate command at it with --file. Product ids are tenant-specific, so this example
How to judge a case: run the query, look at what a human would call a good gift for that
request, and list those product ids. 10-20 well-judged cases already tell you whether a
prompt change helped; ~100 makes the number stable enough to trust small differences.
Include the failures on purpose — queries that return nothing today are the ones a better
blurb should fix, and they are invisible if the set only contains easy wins.

cases.query: Recomiendame un regalo para una mujer de 32 años, creativa y amante del diseño y el café
cases.note: Persona-style request with no product noun — the case the semantic profile exists for.

cases.query: algo para mi hermano de 25 que le gustan las cosas caras
cases.note: Vague premium signal, no explicit number.

cases.query: un regalo para mi mamá en su cumpleaños, menos de $50
cases.note: Budget must become a real filter — nothing over $50 should appear.

cases.query: a gift for a coworker who likes coffee, under $30
cases.note: English against a Spanish catalog — cross-language retrieval.
Bare product noun — must still work when the shopper types like a search box.
